definitions.explanation: the quality of being useful or beneficial for a particular purpose

examples.japanese: この{薬|くすり}の{有用性|ゆうようせい}が{証明|しょうめい}された。
examples.english: The usefulness of this medicine has been proven.

examples.japanese: AIの{有用性|ゆうようせい}について{議論|ぎろん}が{続|つづ}いている。
examples.english: Debate continues about the usefulness of AI.

examples.japanese: {臨床|りんしょう}{試験|しけん}で{新|あたら}しい{治療法|ちりょうほう}の{有用性|ゆうようせい}と{安全性|あんぜんせい}を{検証|けんしょう}する。
examples.english: Clinical trials verify the usefulness and safety of new treatments.

notes:
Composed of {有用|ゆうよう} (useful) + {性|せい} (nature, quality). A formal/academic term used in research, medicine, business, and policy contexts to discuss whether something has practical value.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {有用性|ゆうようせい}を{検証|けんしょう}する: to verify usefulness
- {有用性|ゆうようせい}が{高|たか}い: highly useful
- {有用性|ゆうようせい}を{示|しめ}す: to demonstrate usefulness
- {有用性|ゆうようせい}と{安全性|あんぜんせい}: usefulness and safety
- {有用性|ゆうようせい}が{認|みと}められる: usefulness is recognized

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {有効性|ゆうこうせい}: effectiveness — whether something actually produces the desired result
- {実用性|じつようせい}: practicality — whether something is practical in real-world use
- {利便性|りべんせい}: convenience — how convenient something is to use
- {有用|ゆうよう}: useful — the base adjective form
